-अह्न, i. e. अहन् + अ, A substitute for अहन् in the latter part of some compound words, e. g. पराह्न and पराहन्, i. e. पर-, m. The afternoon.
 पूर्व-, and प्र-, m. The forenoon,
अह्नाय, (properly dat. sing. of the preceding), adv. Soon,

आह्निक, i. e. अहन् + इक,
 I. adj. Daily,

.
 II. n. A religious ceremony which must be performed every day,
